answer: According to **SPARLING**, the authors report that on synthetic domains they were able to “**precisely localize the intermediate states up to feature permutation with >90% accuracy**” while training end-to-end. This is stated on **`conf_iclr_gupta2025sparling.pdf`, page 1** (the same wording also appears in **`DBLP_journals_corr_abs-2302-01976.pdf`, page 1**).
